evidence_standards.SOURCE_SUPPORTED: Backed by public incident reports, repository issue trackers, or published post-mortems
evidence_standards.INFERENCE: Logical deduction from observed technical symptom

prospect_audits.observed_public_pain: Multi-agent systems entering unhandled execution loops and mutex contention deadlocks. [SOURCE_SUPPORTED]
prospect_audits.likely_decision_criteria: Zero repository access required, fast 24h turnaround, actionable drop-in code fixes. [INFERENCE]
prospect_audits.likely_objection: Can you actually diagnose anything useful without seeing our prompts or repo? [HYPOTHESIS]
prospect_audits.what_new_info_helps: The 4-point diagnostic checklist demonstrating log-schema & exit code analysis. [SOURCE_SUPPORTED]
